overrides.reason: Rule: mutating a *url.URL that may be shared. All five matches (hdf-converters/fetchers/defectdojo/go/defectdojo.go:152, fetchers/sonarqube/go/sonarqube.go:409, :472 and :560, fetchers/splunk/go/splunk.go:250) mutate the URL returned by ValidateAndBuildAPIURL in hdf-converters/fetchers/shared/go/shared.go, which parses its input and returns a freshly allocated url.URL on every call. No other reference to that value exists, so the mutation is local to the caller. Triaged 2026-09-07 by reading the constructor and each call site. Revisit if the shared helper starts caching or returning a package-level URL.

Rule: json.Unmarshal into interface{}. The four matches (hdf-converters/shared/go/anchor.go:57 CountJSONItemsUnderKey, goldenmask.go:34 MaskVolatileJSON, testing.go:248 RunSnapshotTestsRaw, testing.go:259 normalizeVolatileFields) are test-support helpers that decode this repository's own golden fixtures for structural comparison; two take a *testing.T and the other two are called only from those. They sit in non-_test.go files so that several packages' tests can import them, which is why the *_test.go exclusion does not cover them. No converter or CLI path calls them and no untrusted document reaches them. Triaged 2026-09-07 by listing every caller. Revisit if any of these helpers gains a non-test caller.

Rule: angle-bracketed text inside a template literal, taken as HTML assembled from data. None of the three is markup: hdf-converters/shared/typescript/checklist/ckl.ts:93 is an error message naming the iSTIG and VULN XML elements, hdf-schema/src/create-index.ts:72 and site/schema-render.mjs:62 write TypeScript generic types (Readonly<Record<...>>, Map<string, ...>) into generated source and documentation text. No result is handed to a browser or an HTML sink. Triaged 2026-09-07. Revisit if the site renderer starts building markup from interpolated values.

Rule: RegExp compiled from a non-literal. hdf-converters/shared/typescript/anchor.ts:24 is countXmlElements, a test-only anchor helper whose every caller passes a literal element name; hdf-schema/src/generate-types.ts:220 is a build script whose field names come from this repository's own schema; hdf-engine/src/safematch.ts:57 is safeGlobMatch, which rejects a glob over 256 bytes and rejects the expanded regex over the same cap before compiling, and returns false on a compile error. Triaged 2026-09-07 by reading every caller. Revisit if a new call site compiles a pattern taken from scanned input.

Rule: regex with overlapping quantifiers. hdf-mappings/scripts/generate-awsconfig-mappings.mjs:178 is a build-time script over AWS's own conformance-pack text, and its repeated group is a parenthesized [^)]* that cannot cross the closing parenthesis, so there is one way to match and nothing to backtrack over. hdf-converters/converters/twistlock-to-hdf/typescript/converter.ts:206 (FIX_VERSION_REGEX, used at :216) does overlap: the trailing character class accepts everything the repeated dot-digits group can, but that same fact means the match succeeds as soon as digits-dot-digits is found and never backtracks into the group; the worst case is a quadratic scan of a status string holding a long digit run with no dot. The input is a Twistlock report the operator chose to convert, already size-capped by validateInputSize. Accepted as low risk, not a false positive. Revisit if the fix-version parsing is rewritten or the input path changes.
